name: 書体と太字の設定
prompt:
Generate ONE isolated Japanese font settings card. Input1 ORIGINAL Speechify screenshot is PRIMARY for chevron glyph geometry, control proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment and spacing. Input2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY exact text/layout. Input3 approved official finish only, no bus content. Focus exclusively source crop x48 y1967 width1083 height297 in1180x2676 screenshot.
Card width358 height100 logical units, 14px radius, white inside, fine neutral #E4E4E4 outline, white canvas compact padding. Two rows separated by one 1px neutral divider, inset16 each side. No shadow or barely perceptible restrained shadow.
ALL text exactly Meiryo REGULAR40014px line24px letterspacing0. No bold even label 「太字」: the label's meaning does not change its weight. Fine regular strokes and native mock text density. Top-left 「書体」 dark #1D1D1D, top-right 「メイリオ」 mutedgray #6E6E6E followed by a small separate RIGHT chevron icon from ORIGINAL, not oversized Japanese bracket. Chevron supporting slate #526173, thin optical weight. Lower-left 「太字」 same Regular14, right OFF toggle: palegray rounded54x30 track, white22px circular thumb LEFT with4px inset. Keep switch off as original. No green because this isolated control has no active primary action. White ordinary surfaces, no mint, no text/captions/title outside card, no English, no icons besides one chevron, no extra settings. Match original control anatomy and locked Japanese typography. High-resolution flat clean raster UI.
reviewNotes: Inspected output: exact Japanese Regular labels including太字; neutral white two-row card; original small chevron restored as separate slate icon; OFF toggle left. Engine adds outer white padding for wide component. No active primary color needed. Source detail hierarchy applied. Exact native font metrics/actions unproven; agent raster visual review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
